# Criar pedido
client: App cliente
gw: API Gateway
auth: Token válido? [diamond]
e401: 401 Unauthorized [ellipse] {color=#e03131} {end} {highlight=#ff6b6b}
etag: If-Match confere? [diamond]
e412: 412 Precondition\nFailed [ellipse] {color=#f08c00} {end} {highlight=#ffa94d}
svc: Order Service
stock: Tem estoque? [diamond]
e409: 409 Conflict [ellipse] {color=#e03131} {end} {highlight=#ff6b6b}
ok: 201 Created [ellipse] {color=#2f9e44} {end} {highlight=#69db7c}
client -> gw: POST /orders
gw -> auth
auth -> e401: não
auth -> etag: sim
etag -> e412: não
etag -> svc: sim
svc -> stock
stock -> e409: não
stock -> ok: sim

children.title: Documentação OpenAPI
children.subtitle: Um contrato OpenAPI no card. Clique na miniatura para abrir a documentação ao lado do mapa.

images.source:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Loja Demo
  version: 1.2.0
  description: API de exemplo para o card.
servers:
  - url: https://petstore3.swagger.io/api/v3
paths:
  /pet/findByStatus:
    get:
      tags: [pet]
      summary: Busca pets por status
      parameters:
        - name: status
          in: query
          schema: {type: string, enum: [available, pending, sold], default: available}
      responses:
        '200': {description: OK}
  /pet/{petId}:
    get:
      tags: [pet]
      summary: Busca um pet
      parameters:
        - {name: petId, in: path, required: true, schema: {type: integer}}
      responses:
        '200': {description: OK}
        '404': {description: Não encontrado}
    delete:
      tags: [pet]
      summary: Apaga um pet
      parameters:
        - {name: petId, in: path, required: true, schema: {type: integer}}
      responses:
        '200': {description: OK}
  /pet:
    post:
      tags: [pet]
      summary: Cria um pet
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: {type: object, properties: {name: {type: string}, status: {type: string}}}
      responses:
        '200': {description: OK}
  /store/inventory:
    get:
      tags: [store]
      summary: Inventário
      responses:
        '200': {description: OK}
